cd /Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')

# 1. declare the module
p = root / 'src/types/checker/mod.rs'
t = p.read_text()
old = "pub mod builtin_user_filter;"
if old not in t:
    import re
    m = re.search(r'^(pub )?mod builtin_user_filter;$', t, re.M)
    old = m.group(0)
new = old + "\npub(crate) mod tentative_return_types;"
assert t.count(old) == 1, 'module declaration anchor not found'
t = t.replace(old, new, 1)

# 2. the checker field
old = "    pub widened_scalar_locals: HashSet<(String, String)>,"
assert t.count(old) == 1
new = (old + "\n    /// php's tentative-return deprecations, computed while linking and emitted at startup.\n"
       "    pub tentative_return_deprecations: Vec<(u32, String)>,")
t = t.replace(old, new, 1)

# 3. carry it into CheckResult
old = "        widened_scalar_locals: checker.widened_scalar_locals,"
assert t.count(old) == 1
t = t.replace(old, old + "\n        tentative_return_deprecations: checker.tentative_return_deprecations,", 1)
p.write_text(t)

# 4. the result field
p = root / 'src/types/result.rs'
t = p.read_text()
old = "    pub widened_scalar_locals: HashSet<(String, String)>,"
assert t.count(old) == 1
new = (old + "\n    /// `(line, message)` for every built-in method with a TENTATIVE return type that a user\n"
       "    /// class overrides without one. php raises these while LINKING the class, so they are\n"
       "    /// emitted from the main prologue rather than at any call site.\n"
       "    pub tentative_return_deprecations: Vec<(u32, String)>,")
t = t.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(t)

# 5. the initializer
p = root / 'src/types/checker/driver/init.rs'
t = p.read_text()
old = "            widened_scalar_locals: HashSet::new(),"
assert t.count(old) == 1
t = t.replace(old, old + "\n            tentative_return_deprecations: Vec::new(),", 1)
p.write_text(t)
print('the checker carries the deprecation list')
